Name: Creative Warehouse Shed
Author: CreativeNat
Description:
[center]Tired of running out of space on your farm? Too many machines and chests?
Well look no further, this shed mod will give you plenty of space to storage everything or even starting your own factory.

It changes both Shed and Big Shed, and won't mess up any items you place inside before upgrading.

Unfortunately, because Farmhouse Redone is currently broken you can't change any of the Wallpapers or the Carpet, when that updates I will add a customizable version.
If you have requests for other designs let me know and I will try to accommodate that.

CHANGELOG
V1.1: added slightly smaller alternative version for Big Shed, use Generic Mod Config Menu to select it.
